highlights.title: OpenAI Is Open to Slowing Cutting-Edge AI, CEO Sam Altman Tells Staff
highlights.description: OpenAI is considering slowing down the development of cutting-edge artificial intelligence, and the ChatGPT maker’s Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman is hoping other AI companies will do the same.

alsoIn.title: OpenAI Weighs Slowing Cutting-Edge AI Development

highlights.title: Trump dismisses AI extinction risks as more than a dozen OpenAI, Anthropic insiders call for a slowdown
highlights.description: Trump said he isn't concerned AI could cause human extinction as researchers at leading AI companies warn about rapid advances and lawmakers propose safeguards.

highlights.title: Why fears of AI self-improvement are causing ‘existential’ concerns at Anthropic and OpenAI
highlights.description: AI researchers are warning that faster AI self-improvement could eventually make advanced systems harder for humans to control.

highlights.title: Chinese AI labs secretly used millions of Claude exchanges to train their models, Anthropic says
highlights.description: Anthropic said it detected unauthorized efforts by China-based AI labs including Alibaba and Moonshot AI to use its Claude models to help improve their own AI systems.

highlights.title: Why OpenAI’s Sam Altman Says He’s Ready to Slow AI Development
highlights.description: CEO Sam Altman hopes that other companies will do the same.

highlights.title: Anthropic Says Yemeni Cell Used Claude in Missile Development
highlights.description: Anthropic PBC uncovered a group in northern Yemen — where Iran-backed Houthi militants operate — using its Claude AI model to support the development of missile and rocket systems, highlighting growing concerns over the use of advanced AI in military programs and by non-state actors.

highlights.title: Why Bridgewater's CIO Says AI's Human Extinction Risk Is Real
highlights.description: Greg Jensen was one of the earliest backers of both OpenAI and Anthropic, and at Bridgewater, where he is the managing chief investment officer, he leads the hedge fund's AI strategy. As an early adopter of the technology, he has a lot of thoughts on where things stand right now in terms of model capability and safety, as well as the broader economic impacts of AI. highlights.title: Broadcom’s VMware Curbs Face Fresh EU Antitrust Scrutiny
highlights.description: Broadcom Inc.’s licensing overhaul for VMware Inc. software after its $61 billion takeover is attracting deeper scrutiny from European Union antitrust watchdogs amid concerns customers are being made to suffer.

highlights.title: Anthropic says Claude thwarted bioweapon research from state-sponsored actors — covert accounts used U.S. proxies to attempt to engineer deadlier viruses, tried to evade identification and regional blocks
highlights.description: Anthropic claims Claude refused instructions to potentially develop biological weapons — alleged state-linked accounts tried to evade identification and regional blocks

ai.description: Greg Jensen, the co-chief investment officer of one of the world’s largest hedge funds, issued a dire warning about the risks and consequences of the artificial intelligence boom Friday on Bloomberg’s Odd Lots podcast.

devices.title: John Ternus and Greg Joswiak reveal why now is the time for iPhone Duo
devices.description: Following this week’s Apple event, new Apple CEO John Ternus and marketing SVP Greg Joswiak sat down for an interview to talk more about the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo. In the interview with Tom’s Guide and TechRadar, Ternus and Joswiak discussed why Apple decided that now was the time to enter the foldable market. Ternus also touched on his feelings after his first week as Apple CEO. more…

ev_autonomous.description: The prediction-market operator plans to seek U.S. approval for about 60 stock and ETF perps, taking one of crypto's biggest trading products into equities.
